cohort: The study involved 182 preterm neonates with a gestational age of less than 37 weeks and a birth weight of less than 1500g, divided into healthy and sepsis cohorts.
finding: The study found significant differences in gut microbial patterns between healthy and sepsis neonates, highlighting the role of initial gut colonization in neonatal health outcomes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery significantly influenced gut flora, with normal vaginal delivery (NVD) linked to a higher prevalence of beneficial bacteria (Enterococcus faecalis and Bifidobacterium spp.).
